newsitem.title: EGYPT: Heliopolis Housing half-yr profits up.
newsitem.headline: Heliopolis Housing half-yr profits up.

text.p: Heliopolis Housing and Development said on Sunday it made net after-tax profits of 38.823 million pounds ($11.44 million) in the first six months of the financial year 1996/7 (starting July 1), 25 percent up on 31.022 million in the same period of 1995/6.
The profits are equivalent to 7.85 pounds for each of the 4,944,760 shares, which closed on the Egyptian stock exchange last week at 440.00 pounds a share.

At the end of the six-month period on December 31, the state's National Construction and Development Company owned 72.86 percent of the equity and the employee shareholders association 10 percent. The balance of 17.14 percent has been sold to the private sector.
